summary: Prove catalan_G_numerical_bounds : G > 0.915 ∧ G < 0.916 (currently axiom with [lewin1981] ref)
comment: BorromeanVolumeCatalan.lean line ~98 has `axiom catalan_G_numerical_bounds : catalan_G > (0.915:ℝ) ∧ catalan_G < (0.916:ℝ)` (set during 2026-06-03 session a7f80972 batch). Proof strategy: alternating series Leibniz bound. For G = Σ (-1)^k/(2k+1)² with N terms, |G - S_N| ≤ 1/(2N+1)². Pick N so S_N ± 1/(2N+1)² ⊆ (0.915, 0.916). Mathlib lemma VERIFIED 2026-06-03 (PR #1763): `alternating_series_error_bound` in `Mathlib/Analysis/SpecificLimits/Normed.lean` has exactly the right signature (Antitone f → Summable f → |∑'(-1)^i·f i - ∑ range n (-1)^i·f i| ≤ f n). Container has working `lake` (post-#1755), so the previously-cited blockers (`no lake` + `lean_leansearch SSL-blocked`) are RESOLVED. Remaining blocker: `lake exe cache get` returns 403 on all 7335 Mathlib oleans downloads (Mathlib cache host shares the same network-policy block as release.lean-lang.org for elan). Building Mathlib from source would take ~1-4h on first run. See `infra-lean-cache-host-bypass` item for the parallel-to-#1755 infra fix needed.

data.proof_sketch: 1. Show series is alternating with antitone |terms| via `Antitone.cauchySeq_alternating_series_of_tendsto_zero`. 2. Use Leibniz error bound |G - S_N| ≤ a_{N+1}. 3. At N=22, compute S_22 as rational + norm_num. 4. linarith with 1/2209 envelope.
data.blocker: needs Mathlib oleans cache; `lake exe cache get` returns 403 (PR #1763 documents the parallel-to-#1755 host bypass needed)
